```yaml
name: Copilot Agent Environment Setup

on:
  workflow_call:

jobs:
  setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: oxc-project/setup-rust@v1
        with:
          # The action automatically reads rust-toolchain.toml
          # No explicit toolchain needed here

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install pnpm
        run: npm install -g pnpm@10.13.1

      - name: Install project dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Install cargo-binstall
        run: cargo install cargo-binstall

      - name: Install just
        run: cargo install just

      - name: Install development tools
        run: |
          cargo binstall -y \
            watchexec-cli \
            cargo-insta \
            typos-cli \
            cargo-shear \
            dprint

      - name: Verify tool versions
        run: |
          echo "just version:" && just --version || true
          echo "cargo-binstall version:" && cargo-binstall --version || true
          echo "watchexec-cli version:" && watchexec-cli --version || true
          echo "cargo-insta version:" && cargo insta --version || true
          echo "typos-cli version:" && typos --version || true
          echo "cargo-shear version:" && cargo shear --version || true
          echo "dprint version:" && dprint --version || true

      - name: Run cargo check
        run: cargo check

      - name: Completion message
        run: |
          echo "Copilot agent environment setup complete."
          echo "Available commands: just ready, just fmt, just test, just lint, etc."
```
